full_judgment:
2. This civil petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 11.03.2013 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in First Appeal No. 356 of 2011 with Civil Rule No. 171 (F) of 2012 and Civil Order No. 02 of 2012 dismissing the appeal with cost of TK. 50,000/- as condition precedent and disposing of the Civil Rule and Civil Order and thereby affirming the judgment and decree dated 16.08.2011 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, Fifth Court, Dhaka in Money Suit No. 20 of 2006 decreeing the suit. 

 3. The respondent, Md. Golam Kibria, as the plaintiff instituted Money Suit No. 20 of 2006 impleading leave-petitioners as defendants seeking a decree for realization of Tk. 6,51,850/- (six lac fifty one thousand eight hundred fifty) only as his arrear salary and benefit as mentioned in the schedule to the plaint. 

 4. The trial Court decreed the suit with costs for an amount of Tk. 6,51,850/- (six lac fifty one thousand eight hundred fifty) against defendant Nos. 1-3. Against the judgment and decree, the defendants filed First Appeal No. 356 of 2011 before the High Court Division. The High Court Division dismissed the appeal with cost of Tk. 50,000/- as condition precedent and the connected Civil Rule No. 171 (F) 2012 and Civil Order No. 02 of 2012 were disposed of accordingly.
